summary: Poem recited in social media video; freedom of speech under Article 19(1)(a); non-violent message promoting resistance through love; no incitement to violence or communal disharmony; symbolic reference to 'throne' as authority causing injustice; police insensitivity in registering FIR; constitutional right violation; impugned High Court judgment quashed.
legal_provisions_cited: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 s.196, s.197(1), s.302, s.299, s.57, s.3(5)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; FIR quashed; no interference with right to freedom of speech and expression.
